data.title: 洛茜 · 观测台侧的电磁微光
data.action: 坐在高脚仪器箱上，一手摆弄着战术探测仪天线，一手轻按在膝间睡裙边缘，金铜色发丝微卷，抬眼迎向管理员，神情从容带着一丝探究。
data.location: 终末地技术探索部前哨站，观测窗口外是塔卫二苍凉的荧光矿脉
data.lighting: 仪表盘泛出的淡琥珀暖光与窗外矿脉的幽蓝冷光交相辉映
data.mood: 科技前哨站的硬朗冰冷与研究员少女的知性温存碰撞
data.description: 终末地技术探索部前哨站，观测窗口外是塔卫二苍凉的荧光矿脉。坐在高脚仪器箱上，一手摆弄着战术探测仪天线，一手轻按在膝间睡裙边缘，金铜色发丝微卷，抬眼迎向管理员，神情从容带着一丝探究。 她微微抬眸轻语——“电磁信号侦测完毕，目前读数一切平稳。管理员……今晚就留在观测台，别回去了。”
data.promptProse: Perched calmly atop a tall equipment crate inside an Endfield frontier observation outpost at night, Rossi wears a bronze-gold silk strappy bralette trimmed with sheer black mesh panels, miniature buckles, and low-rise boyleg briefs. Adjusting the antenna of a handheld scanner with one hand while resting the other at her thigh, she meets the viewer's gaze with composed curiosity. Warm amber console light inside the cabin blends with cold luminescent cyan mineral veins glowing beyond the reinforced panoramic window.
data.animaCaption: Seated atop an outpost equipment crate in her bronze-gold silk strappy bralette and sheer black mesh boyleg briefs, Rossi adjusts a portable scanner antenna and looks steadily toward the viewer. Warm console glow meets alien cyan light from the mineral veins outside the window.
data.nsfwProse: She wears a bronze-gold silk strappy bralette with sheer black mesh side panels, miniature tactical buckles, and matching low-rise boyleg briefs.
